def process(fireWeather):
    import pandas as pd

    # Ensure numeric
    df = fireWeather.copy()
    df['avrh_mean'] = pd.to_numeric(df['avrh_mean'], errors='coerce')
    df['fatalities_last'] = pd.to_numeric(df['fatalities_last'], errors='coerce')

    overall_avg = df['fatalities_last'].mean()
    low_hum_avg = df.loc[df['avrh_mean'] < 30, 'fatalities_last'].mean()

    diff = low_hum_avg - overall_avg
    return pd.DataFrame({'diff': [diff]})

operators.customDisplayName: Compute overall mean fatalities (fatalities_last) across all records; compute mean fatalities for subset with avrh_mean < 30 (humidity <30%); return difference (low-humidity mean minus overall mean) as single-row DataFrame column 'diff'.
